metadata.title: Cinematic Fire and Portrait Soundtrack Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A dramatic close-up portrait of a female protagonist framed by a bow string, featuring intense warm lighting, fire effects, and heavy metallic display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, warm-toned composition featuring a tight facial crop of a woman, bisected by a diagonal bowstring, with a central flaming emblem and bold, beveled metallic text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal bowstring creates a strong leading line across the face
Central flaming emblem acts as a secondary focal point below the eyes
Warm orange and red light from below creates dramatic under-lighting
Heavy metallic typography anchors the bottom third of the frame
coreInvariants: Diagonal line bisecting the facial portrait
Beveled metallic texture on display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up of a face occupying the top two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central flaming circular emblem and the large metallic title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's gaze, follow the diagonal bowstring down to the flaming emblem, and rest on the horizontal text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject, fire effects, and large typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the shadows and hair.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant oranges and yellows from the fire and lighting.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and bronze metallic tones in the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with deep shadows and glowing, highly saturated highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Warm spectrum only (red, orange, yellow, brown, gold)

characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars are elongated to emphasize width
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Unified family approach using different weights and tracking of the same geometric skeleton.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the square, wide geometric structure.
Provides the necessary horizontal stretch and modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic close-up of a woman's face with a dark bowstring cutting diagonally across the frame. Use warm under-lighting and add a central flaming circular bird emblem at the bottom center with sparks and embers flying across the dark background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, centered, two-line display text in an extra-wide, beveled metallic gold sans-serif font over the emblem. Add a single line of wide-tracked subtitle text at the very bottom in a matching gold color.

verificationChecks: Is the bowstring a clear diagonal line?
Is the lighting predominantly warm and fiery?
Is the main text beveled and metallic?
Is the subtitle text widely tracked?

mustRedesign: Any specific logos or trademarked icons
Exact facial features of the actress
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the fire.
Ensure the diagonal line does not obscure the eyes.
Confirm the color palette is strictly warm.
recipe.reuseFormula: Cinematic Portrait + Diagonal Framing Element + Flaming Emblem + Beveled Metallic Typography
